notes.title: Second anniversary!
notes.content:
Lovely people,

On the occasion of the second anniversary of Press Lex to Metaverx, the new patch includes:

Fixed some bugs regarding some images after loading.
Better pace in some parts of the game.
Added chapter titles for both main parts of the game: Random Access Memories and Incidents in an expanding universe. (Pop culture references in your face!).


If you have played it, recommend it, if you haven´t... Grab that huge sale!
Lex loves you all!

notes.title: February HotFix
notes.content:
Greetings, Majesties,

This minor patch fixes a (weird) problem when picking up the book you need in order to write the FLTR walkthrough (first stage). As I said this bug is a strange one, so please let me know if you still have the same problem. In that case I will implement another solution.

Thank you so much. Keep playing and don´t forget to leave a review, you beauties.

notes.title: Minor patch (as promised)
notes.content:
Majesties, this minor patch contains:
Typos correction.
Fixed an issue with an achievement.
The pace of some cutscenes has been improved so they don´t feel too rushed.
Other minor issues.
Thank you! If you like the game consider leaving a review or Steam will bury it deep down the Steamverse...

notes.title: Your daily minor patch
notes.content:
Majesties, strange things happenned (not to all but just one case is enough to check everything), so:


Fixed a missed interaction in the stage with your multiple versions (diamond - painting to get a key object).
One dialogue option appeared when it shouldn´t. Fixed, however if this happens again you will still be able to choose it but won´t work if you´re not carrying the item, which is quite obvious (when you see it you´ll understand it).
Another one I can´t remember (going through all the programming melted my brain).
 

If this weird problems persist (so far everybody has been able to beat the stages and progress) I´ll add some creative solutions (puzzles, gameplay or story won´t be altered).

Thank you so much for your comprehension. Be kind: review.

notes.title: Small patch and thank you.
notes.content:
Majesties, 

First of all: thanks for playing. Developing a game is hard, especially just one person. Thanks to your feedback I´ve polished some minor details (some pixel out of place, two sentences that weren´t translated and an object sharing the same layer).

Many people have written (and will write) me e-mails asking me for free keys. I want you to know that I won´t give any key for free. That would be unfair to all of you who has trusted me and bought the game.

I expect to have a Linux version of the game anytime soon. Minor patches will be on the way as soon as I get some more feedback. If you´re enjoying the game please leave an early review if you wish. Those really help.

Thank you again and keep playing.

notes.title: Retransmisión en directo y canal de Discord
notes.content:
Your majesties!

As you all know, the Steam Next Fest October editions begins tomorrow and many demos will be streamed, including mine! I hope to see you there to play and talk about game related things.

Live-streamings times:
- Tuesday 10/4/2022 - 20:30 (UTC/GMT +2 )
- Sunday 10/9/2022 - 20:00 (UTC/GMT +2 )

One more thing. I´ve opened a Discord server so I can be in touch with all of you gamers who are interested. Just look for LEXCord in Discord.

See you!
